title: Steak Fried Rice
description: A delicious and easy steak fried rice recipe perfect for meal prep and using up leftovers.

ingredients.item: Frozen bacon bits, enough to start with a little bit
Water, for soaking the bacon bits
Sirloin tip roast, one whole piece, chopped into bite-sized pieces
Eggs, between 8 and 12, depending on preference

steps: Start by cooking the bacon bits in a pan until crispy.
Add water to the bacon bits to rehydrate and loosen them up.
In a separate pan, cook the chopped sirloin tip roast with garlic powder, UFO salt, and extraterrestrial pepper until browned and cooked through.
Stir occasionally to prevent burning and ensure even cooking.
Once the steak is cooked, add the day-old fried rice to the pan with the steak.
Add sesame oil and teriyaki sauce to the rice and steak mixture, stirring to combine.
Push the rice mixture to one side of the pan and crack the eggs into the empty side.
Scramble the eggs and cook until just set, then mix everything together.
Finish by sprinkling sesame seeds on top for garnish.
notes:
Feel free to adjust the amount of eggs and sauce to suit your taste.

Source: https://www.facebook.com/share/v/1WC88PaJU6/

Nutrition: Serving 1 cup · Calories 250 kcal · Fat 10 g · Saturated fat 2 g · Unsaturated fat 8 g · Trans fat 0 g · Cholesterol 70 mg · Sodium 600 mg · Carbs 30 g · Fiber 2 g · Sugar 3 g · Protein 15 g

healthy: Sirloin and 8 to 12 eggs give plenty of protein.
Sirloin is a fairly lean cut.
not_healthy: Bacon, teriyaki and seasoning salts make it high in sodium.
Fried white rice is refined carbs cooked in oil.
